replies.author: EncryptedShoesHD
replies.body:
Hey popper8890! 

Yeah, I am the mod who banned you. I banned you for autoarmor because my friends sent me an evidence which resulted as sufficient. However, in the video clip you can see that you were fighting a player and when he died, you got equipped instantly. That doesn't seem like a legit think as nobody can't equip himself that fast. 

Evidence can be found here: http://sendvid.com/raedy0b9

If you'd like discuss about it, feel free reply/ask me for a skype name. 

Regards,
DeliciousShoesHD (Avicus MOD)
